item.title: Legendary Investor Ric Edelman Sees Bitcoin Reaching $500,000 by 2030

item.title: Crypto CEO Explains How the Wealthy Use Assets Like XRP to Build Long-Term Wealth Without Selling
item.description: Jake Claver, CEO of Digital Ascension Group, has explained how wealthy investors use assets like XRP not for sale, but as collateral to unlock liquidity while preserving long-term upside. In a recent post on X, Claver stated: “The wealthy don’t usually sell their assets; they borrow against them instead.” He argued that the same strategy commonly used with real estate and equities can also apply to digital assets such as Bitcoin and XRP.Visit Website
